vote.text: The Council adopted draft S/2022/980 as resolution 2669 (2022), by 12 votes in favour, none against and three abstentions.
The United Kingdom voted in favour. China, India and Russia abstained.

mandate.text: demands an immediate end to violence, calls for humanitarian access, and acknowledges ASEAN's central role
the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, to report orally to the Security Council by 15 March 2023
